config_object: r0 on entry to the 0801d888 dispatcher; offsets are byte offsets from that base
limits: Values are the values a setter WRITES, not the runtime value of the object; callbacks invoked between dispatch rows may add more.
sku / devicesn / hwrev are runtime fields; only the sku==4 branch is modelled explicitly (sku==0 and sku==4 snapshot pairs).
K34 / K35 / 08011100 can further change +0x1a4 / +0x194 after the setter sequence; those callbacks are outside this snapshot.
No firmware was executed and no device was contacted.
